integrity: Explicit analytical proof and finite-size reproducibility checker are included; finite enumeration is not a proof of the asymptotic theorem. No external independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: The spatial Poisson crossover is proved for homogeneous nearest-neighbor hard-core equilibrium configurations on growing cycles with fugacity divided by cycle size squared converging to a finite positive value. The scalar independence polynomial is established prior work. Historical originality against broad low-temperature Ising and transfer-matrix literature remains uncertain; an identified 1986 specialist paper was not read in full. No independent scientific audit has been conducted.
title: A parity-conditioned Poisson crossover for defects in a high-fugacity hard-core ring
